Vanishing Shift.name: Vanishing Shift
Vanishing Shift.description: The user throws a feint, breaks line of sight behind a pillar, smoke or a crowd and moves somewhere else. Every opponent loses track of the user until the user attacks or makes a noise, and while unseen the user can move anywhere in the area, including behind an opponent. Sensing Quirks, heat vision and cameras can still find the user. Stamina: demanding.
